CustomField.description: The answer in one easy-to-read column, whatever the question type (Yes or No, the number, the date or the text). Blank until answered (Robert, 2026-11-27).
CustomField.label: Answer
CustomField.formula: CASE(ROSA_Answer_Type__c, "Yes/No", TEXT(ROSA_Answer_Yes_No__c), "Number", IF(ISBLANK(ROSA_Answer_Number__c), "", TEXT(ROSA_Answer_Number__c)), "Date", IF(ISBLANK(ROSA_Answer_Date__c), "", TEXT(DAY(ROSA_Answer_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(MONTH(ROSA_Answer_Date__c)) & "/" & TEXT(YEAR(ROSA_Answer_Date__c))), "Text", ROSA_Answer_Text__c, "")
